datasets.title: South Sudan Education Facilities (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['amenity'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') OR tags['building'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') Features may have these attributes: name name:en amenity building operator:type capacity:persons addr:full addr:city source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_ssd_education_facilities]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Education facility locations and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap using standardized amenity and building tags (kindergarten, school, college, university). Data was exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) with both point and polygon geometries to support disaster risk exposure assessment.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.description: Volunteered geographic information (VGI) of education facilities collected and maintained by OpenStreetMap community contributors. Provides facility locations, names, capacity, and operator type information.
